given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner completes a physical handover and captures a digital signature
given_when_then.then: The system validates the proof and releases funds to the Store Partner

given_when_then.given: The external courier API returns an invalid or missing delivery confirmation
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to retrieve proof for a completed delivery
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket and blocks fund release

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner submits a delivery proof for a completed delivery
given_when_then.when: The system receives the proof and it lacks a timestamp or valid signature
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket to flag the delivery as invalid

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner attempts to submit a delivery proof for a cancelled delivery assignment
given_when_then.when: The system processes the submission request
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the delivery proof as invalid

given_when_then.given: The system retrieves a delivery proof via an external API
given_when_then.when: The proof is successfully verified and stored
given_when_then.then: The system treats the proof with the same verification standards as locally captured proof and proceeds with fund release

success_criteria: The system must not release funds to the Store Partner until a valid delivery proof is recorded in the system.
The system must release funds to the Store Partner only after the delivery proof has been successfully verified and stored.
The system must create a Dispute Ticket when a delivery proof lacks a timestamp or valid signature.
The system must reject a delivery proof if the associated Delivery Assignment is marked as cancelled.
The system must validate delivery proofs retrieved via external API using the same standards as locally captured proof.
